about: v4 P0: every voice decision names the rule that made it. `rule` is the question or hit rule behind decide()'s action (null for a confident hit), `save_rule` the save rule behind record()'s outcome (null when the answer was stored). Each case is one call on a fresh store: every turn is decided and, when it needs the model, recorded with its reply; the expectations are for the last turn. `refuse`: the store refuses every write. `private`: the last answer is recorded as built from a tool's result. Rule names are the v4 plan's (sdk-docs/v4-refactor-plan.md, section 4). Checked by python/tests/test_decision_rules.py and node/test-decision-rules.js.

turns: is pad thai safe to eat

turns: my order 48213 has not arrived where is it
